items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: I don't think he was light, was he? He was a little darker. It wasn't Chris.

ctx.x: Yeah, so many of them, yeah, I mixed up with. It wouldn't have been Chris Kelly. No, it wasn't Chris. I don't think he was light, was he? He was a little darker. It wasn't Chris. It wasn't Chris.
I didn't think who it would be then.
